/**
 * @file module.h
 * @brief Public contract for the module's single responsibility.
 * @details State ownership, calling context and synchronization requirements.
 */
#ifndef ROBOPICO_MODULE_H
#define ROBOPICO_MODULE_H

#include <stdint.h>

/**
 * @brief Perform the named operation.
 * @param p_output Non-null destination owned by the caller.
 * @return Status and rejection conditions; acceptance is not completion.
 */
uint32_t module_operation (uint32_t * p_output);

#endif /* ROBOPICO_MODULE_H */

/* End of file. */
